name: Eyebrow gel with fibers
lead: Eyebrow gel with fibers is a cosmetic that combines a brow-setting gel with tiny colored fibers that cling to hairs and skin to make brows look thicker or fill gaps. Wikipedia describes brow gels as adding texture and definition, and notes that powders, pencils and shaders are used to fill sparse areas; fibers specifically are not covered there.[1]
No published clinical studies of fiber brow gels were found in the sources consulted. The product category is cosmetic and does not change hair growth.
infobox: Temporary fill and hold for eyebrows

paras: Brow cosmetics include brushes, pencils, powders and gels in shades matched to natural hair color.[1] Fiber gels add short fibers to the gel formula, which proponents say builds fullness in sparse areas.
Cosmetics used near the eye can cause irritation or allergic reactions in some users. The sources consulted give no product-specific data.

card.summary: Brow gel with tiny fibers that fake fullness; a temporary cosmetic with no clinical research.
card.aka: Fiber brow gel, tinted brow gel

quick.overview:
A brow gel with fibers sets hairs and adds tiny colored fibers that cling to fill gaps. It gives a temporary look of thicker brows.

No clinical studies were found for this product type.
quick.mechanism: The gel holds hairs in place while fibers adhere to hairs and skin to add visual density. It does not affect growth.
quick.risks: Eye-area irritation or allergy is possible with any cosmetic. Sources consulted give no product-specific safety data.
